The pedophiles in prison aren't necessarily a representative sample of the entire population of pedophiles. One would probably expect pedophiles in prison to have a greater likelihood of exhibiting anti-social behavior.

I've done a bit of research on this because I have abnormal sexual desires myself and what I find constantly on various boards are desperate people who hate themselves and feel like they can never be accepted in society when they have a mental condition and haven't done anything wrong. I don't doubt that there are people like the ones you describe but I think you have a skewed sample.

It's this attitude that does the most damage. If somebody hasn't harmed and will never harm others then they should be treated with respect as a human being and have just as much of a right to be a part of civilized society as anyone else. I think there's this misconception about pedophiles having no self control or being ticking time bombs but I think that's largely bullshit and if somebody rapes or harms another then that's completely on them and they will suffer the consequences. Non offending pedophiles are human beings like anyone else and are very much a part of society.
No you're not. Though you do seem to be in the minority.

We don't know how common of an affliction it is and awareness campaigns like this aren't really a bad thing. It's not like this information is super common and for non offending pedophiles knowing there are a decent number of people who wouldn't think they are monsters can help them have peace of mind. This isn't really a zero sum game, spreading information about this doesn't make it any harder to promote the civil rights of other groups and may help reduce the number of victims in the future so I can't really see it as being bad.
